decisions.reason: As a full aloe-vera facial care line with its own page, it appears strategically important and worth keeping open because industry demand is favorable and the firm can learn more at relatively low continuation cost.

The hyaluronic serum fits the firm's natural facial-care portfolio and is inexpensive to continue as an option, but its lower website prominence suggests somewhat weaker commitment or traction than Product A.

The cleansing milk is a plausible complementary staple in the range and likely not costly to retain, yet its limited presentation indicates a higher chance of later pruning if sales feedback stays modest.
